title: 第十九章 孟川的修行路第二十章 父与子
lines: 孟大江看着自己儿子，想到前两日斩妖盛会上儿子和妖怪的搏杀，心中明悟。川儿的翅膀或许还稚嫩，但也的确该让他自己展翅飞了。
“孟川准备修炼神魔体之前，你带他来我这，取神魔玉髓液。”孟仙姑嘱托道。
“是。”孟大江应道。
那一滴神魔玉髓液，珍贵无比。
就是王都的一些古老神魔家族，大多数天才少年也不可能得到一滴神魔玉髓液用来打造神魔根基。一般只有那些天资卓绝，家族百年一出的天才……才得到古老神魔家族的大力栽培。那些神魔家族底蕴也是有限的，哪能如孟家这般孤注一掷？
“孟川，你修行上有什么困惑，也可以来问姑祖母。”孟仙姑笑道，“遇到什么麻烦事也可以来找姑祖母说说。”
“姑祖母。”
孟川立即道，“我的确有一事，如今颇为困惑。”
“怎么达到刀法境界的下一重，对吗？”孟仙姑微笑道。
“是。”孟川点头，“我问过道院院长，院长只是说了，他是自创出一套顶尖刀法方才悟出刀势。”
“这的确是一种方法。”孟仙姑点头，看向孟大江，“大江，你是怎么突破的？”
孟大江一愣，眼中有着一丝追忆，说道：“当初我服兵役，在一支小队中各有分工，我就是负责缠住妖怪。所以主要也就修炼三招刀法……我在沁阳关待了十年。后来离开返乡，也顺道游历周围各府。恰好碰到了一女子和妖怪搏杀。”
孟大江看向孟川，笑道：“那就是你母亲。”
孟川心头一颤。
娘？
“你母亲长的很好看，阳光照射下，你母亲和妖怪厮杀的身影，这一辈子我都不会忘。我当时全身充满力量，想都不想直接冲上去，施展刀法轻易缠住妖怪。那一次，我施展刀法格外空灵，格外轻松。竟然就这么悟出刀势了。”孟大江笑道，“第一次遇到你母亲，我就悟出刀势了，真巧。”
“大江是有战场十年的积累，在这一天直接突破。”孟仙姑说道，“大江仅仅修炼三招刀法，你们镜湖道院院长是自创一套顶尖刀法，你们院长在于博，大江在于精。二者并无高下之分，甚至在纠缠敌人方面你父亲更擅长。”
孟川也点头：“我看过神魔传记，写神魔邓风的。他孤独一人在深山一人练刀，每天拔刀万次，拔刀二十年。刚出山，就以洗髓境实力一刀杀死了一位无漏境。”
“对，能洗髓境杀无漏境，他那一刀……已经超出了刀势的境界。他就是专精的代表，只是他天赋比你父亲高太多了，那一刀太惊艳，被元初山直接招揽。都无需通过考验。”孟仙姑说道，“不过他没有人指点，刀法是有致命缺陷的，缺陷就是他只会那一刀！若是别人了解他的底细，针对他的弱点，他就惨了。当然他刚崭露头角，就被元初山招揽，也很快弥补了弱点。并且使得他擅长的更强大。才真正纵横无敌一个时代。”
孟川微微点头。
“我在安海关待过很久，也得到过安海王指点。”孟仙姑说道，“安海王，实力难以测算，在元初山地位极尊。论实力绝对不亚于你所说的那位神魔邓风。”
孟川当然知道安海王很厉害。
在东宁府，寻常凡俗去服兵役都是去沁阳关！而东宁府的神魔们上战场，大多是去安海关。安海关最高统帅就是安海王。连大周王朝的皇室都无比敬重他，直接封其王位。
“安海王和我说过。”孟仙姑看着孟川，“修行，就是要循着直觉，循着内心中最喜欢的方向，一路前进。你会走的越来越远，当数十年后，你再回头看，你已经远远超越当初的自己。这句话我也送给你。循着直觉，循着你内心中最喜欢的去前行。”
“嗯。”孟川轻轻点头。
孟川回到了镜湖孟府，回到了练武场。
独自一人坐在那，吃着水果，思索着。
“安海王指点姑祖母的那句话，和我整合的修行九条第四条‘匠人和宗师’，是有些共通之处的。”孟川暗道，“既然循着直觉，循着内心最喜欢的。那自然能修炼更‘用心’，更享受其中，痴迷的更深，更有望成宗师。”
“听院长，听老爹，又听姑祖母说了。再依我整合的修行九条来看……”
“接下来该怎么修炼，我也心中有底了。”
孟川其实早有想法。
只是他还是要多听听修炼出势的前辈的指点，相互验证。
“修行九条第六条：自身所学，当自成体系。如此才不会有致命破绽，一名强者决定他生死的，一般是他最致命的短板！只要有一明显的弱点，将来就会被针对。被克制，进而丢了性命！就算你一招鲜吃遍天。胜了十次百次。可只要一次栽了可能就丢了性命。”
“那位神魔邓风，就擅长那一刀！姑祖母也说神魔邓风有致命缺陷，幸好立即被招揽进元初山，弥补了缺点。”
content_en:
Meng Dajiang looked at his son and thought of the fight between his son and the monster at the monster-slaying event two days ago, and he understood clearly. Chuan'er's wings may still be immature, but it's really time for him to spread his wings and fly.
"Before Meng Chuan prepares to cultivate the body of gods and demons, you bring him to my place to get the chalcedony liquid of gods and demons." Meng Xiangu asked.
"Yes." Meng Dajiang responded.
That drop of divine and demon chalcedony liquid is extremely precious.
Even for some of the ancient gods and demon families in the capital, it is impossible for most talented young people to obtain a drop of the god and demon chalcedony liquid to build the foundation of gods and demons. Generally, only those geniuses with outstanding talents, whose families emerge once every hundred years... are vigorously cultivated by the ancient gods and demon families. The foundations of those gods and demon families are also limited. How can they be so desperate as the Meng family?
"Meng Chuan, if you have any confusion about your practice, you can come and ask your great-aunt." Meng Xiangu said with a smile, "If you encounter any trouble, you can come and talk to your great-aunt."
"Great aunt."
Meng Chuan immediately said, "I do have something, and I'm quite confused now."
"How do you reach the next level of swordsmanship, right?" Meng Xiangu said with a smile.
"Yes." Meng Chuan nodded, "I asked the dean of the Taoist Academy, and the dean just said that he only realized the power of the sword after he created a set of top-notch sword techniques."
"This is indeed a method." Meng Xiangu nodded and looked at Meng Dajiang, "Dajiang, how did you break through?"
Meng Dajiang was stunned for a moment, with a hint of recollection in his eyes, and said: "When I was serving in the military, I was assigned to a division of labor in a small team, and I was responsible for trapping monsters. So I mainly practiced the three-move sword technique... I stayed in Qinyang Pass for ten years. Later I left to return to my hometown, and also traveled around the surrounding prefectures. I happened to meet a woman fighting a monster."
Meng Dajiang looked at Meng Chuan and said with a smile, "That's your mother."
Meng Chuan's heart trembled.
mother?
"Your mother is very beautiful. I will never forget the sight of your mother fighting with monsters under the sunlight. I was full of strength at that time, and I rushed forward without thinking, using my sword skills to easily entangle the monsters. That time, my sword skills were particularly ethereal and easy. I realized the power of the sword just like that." Meng Dajiang said with a smile, "The first time I met your mother, I realized the power of the sword. What a coincidence."
"Dajiang has accumulated ten years of experience on the battlefield, and he made a breakthrough on this day." Meng Xiangu said, "Dajiang only practiced three sword techniques, and you, the dean of Jinghu Taoist Academy, created a set of top sword techniques. Your dean is Bo, Dajiang is Jing. There is no difference between the two. Your father is even better at entangling the enemy."
Meng Chuan also nodded: "I have read the biography of the God and Demon, written about the God and Demon Deng Feng. He practiced swordsmanship alone in the mountains, drawing his sword ten thousand times a day for twenty years. As soon as he came out of the mountain, he killed a Wuluo Realm with one sword with the strength of the Marrow Cleansing Realm."
"Yes, he can kill the marrow-cleansing realm and kill the leak-free realm. His sword...has gone beyond the realm of sword power. He is the representative of specialization, but his talent is much higher than your father. That sword is so amazing that he was directly recruited by Yuanchu Mountain. There is no need to pass the test." Meng Xiangu said, "But he has no one to guide him, the sword Fa has a fatal flaw, and the flaw is that he only knows one thing! If others knew his details and targeted his weaknesses, he would be in trouble. Of course, he was recruited by Yuan Chushan as soon as he emerged, and his strengths made him truly invincible. "
Meng Chuan nodded slightly.
"I have stayed in Anhaiguan for a long time and received guidance from King Anhai." Meng Xiangu said, "King Anhai, whose strength is difficult to estimate, has a very high status in Yuanchu Mountain. In terms of strength, he is definitely no less than the god and demon Deng Feng you mentioned."
Of course Meng Chuan knew that King Anhai was very powerful.
In Dongning Prefecture, ordinary people go to Qinyang Pass to perform military service! When the gods and demons of Dongning Prefecture go to the battlefield, most of them go to Anguan Customs. The supreme commander of Anhaiguan is King Anhai. Even the royal family of the Zhou Dynasty respected him extremely and directly granted him the throne.
"King Anhai told me." Meng Xiangu looked at Meng Chuan, "Practice is to follow your intuition and follow the direction you like best in your heart, and move forward all the way. You will go further and further. When you look back decades later, you will have far surpassed yourself. I will also give you this sentence. Follow your intuition and move forward in the direction you like best in your heart."
"Yeah." Meng Chuan nodded lightly.
…
Meng Chuan returned to Jinghu Meng Mansion and the martial arts training ground.
Sitting there alone, eating fruit and thinking.
"The words that King An Hai pointed out to my great-aunt have something in common with the fourth of the nine principles of cultivation that I integrated, 'craftsman and master'." Meng Chuan secretly said, "Since you follow your intuition and what you like best in your heart, you will naturally be able to practice more 'hardly', enjoy it more, become more obsessed, and hopefully become a master."
"Listen to the dean, listen to dad, and listen to what my great-aunt said. And based on the nine principles of spiritual practice that I have integrated..."
"I already know how to practice next."
Meng Chuan actually had an idea.
It's just that he still needs to listen more to the advice of seniors who have become successful in cultivation and verify each other.
"Article 6 of the Nine Practice Rules: What you have learned should form its own system. Only in this way will there be no fatal flaws. The most fatal shortcoming that determines a strong man's life and death is usually his most fatal shortcoming! As long as there is an obvious weakness, it will be targeted in the future. It will be restrained and lose your life! Even if you are successful all over the world with one move, you win ten times and a hundred times. But if you fail once, you may lose your life."
"That god and demon Deng Feng is good at that sword! My aunt also said that the god and demon Deng Feng had a fatal flaw. Fortunately, he was immediately recruited into Yuanchu Mountain to make up for his shortcomings."
title_en: Chapter 19 Meng Chuan’s Cultivation Path Chapter 20 Father and Son
